steps.name: fu2-1-svg-parse
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && test "$(python3 -c "import json;print(len(json.load(open('tools/orb-manager/testdata/svg-vectors.json'))))")" -ge 70 && make check-editor 2>&1 | tee /tmp/fu2-1-ed.txt | tail -5 && grep -qE 'svg-vectors: ([0-9]+)/\1 passed' /tmp/fu2-1-ed.txt && make check-svg-live 2>&1 | tail -5 | tee /tmp/fu2-1-live.txt && grep -q 'accepted 0 fetched' /tmp/fu2-1-live.txt && make check-pictures && test -z "$(git diff --stat fu2 -- tools/orb-manager/contract apps tools/orb-manager/editor.go tools/orb-manager/security.go docs/specs/fu2-svg-rules.md)" && sh docs/specs/s3-gotest.sh && make check-web
